beats.say: Bob Iger just announced his second book titled One Last Time.
According to The Hollywood Reporter, the book arrives on 2 March 2027.
It chronicles his return to Disney before Josh D'Amaro succeeded him as chief executive.
The book revisits what the outlet describes as a sometimes bumpy, never boring era.
Will you be reading Bob Iger's tell-all book when it finally lands?
